_comment: Every package-specific behaviour in the engine enters through this file; the code
itself contains no package-name comparisons (ARCHITECTURE.md section 20).
Entries here are expectations, not measured results. Nothing but the PHASE 2 probe
has been run on a device, so no package is claimed as SUPPORTED, and nothing is
marked UNSUPPORTED - that level is reserved for results measured on hardware.
Phase 7 fills this in from the test matrix.

profiles.note: Imported from the device, never bundled. In-space GMS has no privileged permissions and no attestation; sign-in flows can work, Play Integrity cannot.
Google Services Framework, imported alongside GMS for Mode A.
Expected to need an attested, installed identity. Not investigated on a device yet.
